flows.vessel_class_note: Source data tags this commodity/country pair 'River-sea tanker (Volga-Don Canal, ~5,000dwt/140m lock cap)' by default; physically impossible from a Caspian-basin port (Volga-Don Canal locks cap ~5,000dwt/140m). Relabeled to the vessel class that can actually make the Caspian-to-Black-Sea leg. Caveat: for the longer destinations this flow draws a line to (e.g. Rotterdam, Houston), real Caspian crude almost certainly doesn't travel the whole way on one small river-sea tanker — in practice it moves by pipeline (CPC to Novorossiysk, or BTC to Ceyhan) or is transshipped onto an oceangoing tanker at a Black Sea/Med port partway through. This flow's port-pair and $/yr value are real trade data; its single-vessel-class label is a simplification that breaks down over long inter-basin hauls the same way the pre-fix VLCC label did, just less absurdly.
